baseline debt: typos {"rule": "typos", "path": "scenarios/messages.md", "source": "**B41 a wake request asks to be woken when named Agents finish.** Found by the owner's request #2218: \"Our CLI must have full parity with the MCP\"; 98 of the owner's Solo calls were `timer_fire_when_idle_all` and `_any`; \"events are more accurate - we should have exactly once gurantee to avoid waste or loss\". Given Agent `w` (any Agent, a Door included) and Agents `c1 … cn` in its Project, when `w` calls `agent.wake {ids: [c1 … cn], any?: bool}`, then the Daemon saves one Wake request (`GLOSSARY.md`) for `w` and returns at once `{id, fired}`; `w` ends its turn, holds no call open and no process runs for it. A Kind is *finished* when it is `idle`, `done`, `error` or `needs-you`; `working` and `blocked` are not. (a) Already finished: an id whose Kind is finished when the request is made counts as finished at once, so a request whose condition already holds fires at once (B42) and returns `fired: true`. (b) `all` (the default): the request fires when every named Agent has been finished at some time since the request; a name that finished and then resumed stays finished (the request keeps the set, so nothing is lost to a flip). `any` fires when the first named Agent is finished. (c) Gone: a named Agent that is removed counts as finished with Kind `done`. (d) Refusals, none saving anything: a caller that is not an Agent (the user, an Extension) `FORBIDDEN`; an id that names no Agent in the Project `NOT_FOUND`; the caller's own id, no ids, a repeated id or more than 20 ids `INVALID_PARAMS`; more than 8 open requests for `w` `CONFLICT`. (e) No clock: the Daemon sets no timer for a Wake request; it decides from `agent.status` Events only, and a request whose condition never holds stays saved and costs nothing. (f) A request is `w`'s: it ends with `w` (B9: `w` `done`, or its Attempt ended without a resume, or removed) and is dropped without a note.
